q: Yelp 题的产品核心最准确地说是什么？
q_en: What is the core product being designed in the Yelp problem?
options: 本地商家搜索、浏览和评论平台
在线视频上传和播放平台
实时拼车调度系统
面向商家的广告竞价系统
options_en: A local business search, browsing, and review platform.
An online video upload and playback platform.
A real-time ride-hailing dispatch system.
A business-facing ad auction system.
why: 本题围绕本地商家发现和评论：用户搜索商家、查看商家和评论、留下评分和文字评论。广告、推荐和地图展示都不是主线。
why_en: The Yelp design centers on local business search, business detail viewing, and user reviews, not ads or recommendations.

scenario: 面试官已经把 Yelp 定义为本地商家搜索与评论平台，要求你先划定 MVP 范围内的核心功能。
scenario_en: The interviewer defines Yelp as a local business search and review platform, and asks you to scope the MVP features first.
q: Yelp 本地商家点评网站的核心功能需求有哪些？（多选）
q_en: Which core functional requirements belong in the MVP for a local business review site?
options: 为用户生成个性化推荐流
查看商家详情和评论
给商家留下 1-5 星评分和可选文字评论
按名称、经纬度位置和类别搜索商家
options_en: Generate a personalized recommendation feed for each user.
View business details and their reviews.
Leave a 1-5 star rating with optional text review.
Search businesses by name, lat/long location, and category.
why: 核心功能是商家搜索、详情+评论查看、写评论三件事；个性化推荐和地图展示属于范围外。
why_en: The core functions are searching businesses, viewing details with reviews, and creating reviews — not personalized recommendations.

q: Yelp 题的核心非功能需求包括哪些？（多选）
q_en: Which nonfunctional requirements matter most for the Yelp design?
options: 搜索延迟低于约 500ms
所有评论写入必须跨区域强一致同步
扩展到 100M 日活用户和 10M 商家
高可用，接受最终一致
options_en: Search latency under about 500 milliseconds.
All review writes must be strongly consistent across regions.
Scale to 100M daily active users and 10M businesses.
High availability, with eventual consistency accepted.
why: 核心是低延迟搜索、高可用和百万级规模；评论和搜索结果可接受最终一致，不要求跨区域强一致同步。
why_en: The key nonfunctional requirements are sub-500ms search, high availability with eventual consistency, and scale to 100M users and 10M businesses.

termDefinitions.meaning: 写入后短时间内副本可能不一致，但停止写入后会收敛到相同状态。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Eventual consistency means replicas may briefly disagree after a write but converge once writes stop.

q: Yelp 题里，用来防止刷分和竞对恶意差评的核心业务约束是什么？
q_en: What business rule prevents rating spam and malicious competitor reviews in Yelp?
options: 每个商家最多只能有十条评论
每个用户对每个商家只能留一条评论
每个搜索请求必须返回全量商家
每个城市只能有一个类别
options_en: Each business may have at most ten reviews.
Each user may leave only one review per business.
Every search request must return the full business set.
Each city may only have one category.
why: 一人一商家一评是后续数据库约束深挖的基础，用来防止同一用户刷分或竞品恶意刷差评。
why_en: The key constraint is that each user may leave only one review per business, preventing rating manipulation.

q: 满足核心需求需要哪些核心实体？（多选）
q_en: Which core entities are needed for the main Yelp requirements?
options: Business
User
VideoSegment
Review
options_en: Business — the listed venue entity.
User — the person searching and reviewing.
VideoSegment — a video-platform entity, not part of Yelp.
Review — a rating and optional text tied to a user and business.
why: Business 存商家信息，User 是搜索/写评论的人，Review 连接两者并带评分与文字；VideoSegment 属于视频类系统，不在 Yelp 域内。
why_en: The core entities are Business, User, and Review; VideoSegment belongs to a video platform, not Yelp.

q: 补全 Yelp 核心 API 的形状：
q_en: Fill in the shape of the core Yelp APIs.
text: 搜索商家：{{GET /businesses?query&location&category&page}}；查看详情：{{GET /businesses/:businessId}}；写评论：{{POST /businesses/:businessId/reviews}}。
why: API 基本按功能需求一一映射。搜索需要分页，详情和评论可以合并或拆开，取决于评论分页需求。
why_en: The APIs map directly to search, business detail retrieval, and review creation.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把大结果集拆成多页返回，每次只传输一小部分数据。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Pagination splits a large result set into pages so each request transfers only a small slice.

q: 为什么搜索接口需要 page 参数或其他分页机制？
q_en: Why does the business search API need a page parameter or another pagination mechanism?
options: 让写评论变成异步任务
保证每个商家只能有一条评论
避免一次返回巨大结果集，降低响应体和延迟
替代全文索引
options_en: Turn review writing into an async task.
Guarantee each business has only one review.
Avoid returning a huge result set at once, cutting payload size and latency.
Replace full-text indexing.
why: 搜索结果可能很大，分页可以限制单次 payload，提升响应速度和客户端体验。分页不是索引替代品，只是结果传输控制。
why_en: Pagination keeps search responses small and responsive when the result set may be large.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把大结果集拆成多页返回，每次只传输一小部分数据。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Pagination splits a large result set into pages so each request transfers only a small slice.

scenario: 商家详情页可能有成千上万条评论，用户只需要逐页滚动评论列表。
scenario_en: A business detail page may have thousands of reviews, and users only need to scroll the review list page by page.
q: 详情和评论 API 更合适怎样拆分？
q_en: How should the business detail and review APIs be split?
options: 写评论时顺便返回全站所有评论
只提供一个不分页的大接口
把所有评论嵌入搜索结果里
详情与评论拆成两个 GET 接口，评论单独分页
options_en: Return all site-wide reviews whenever someone posts a review.
Provide one endpoint with no pagination at all.
Embed every review inside the search results.
Split into two GET endpoints: business detail, and a paginated review list.
tradeoff: 接口拆分带来的独立缓存与分页能力 vs 单接口的简单性
why: 拆分后商家详情可以快速返回，评论独立分页加载；评论量很少时也可以合并成一个接口。
why_en: Separating business details from paginated reviews keeps the detail endpoint fast while allowing large review lists to load incrementally.
whenOtherWins: 如果每个商家评论数量很少且页面总是一起展示，一个聚合详情接口更简单。

termDefinitions.meaning: 把大结果集拆成多页返回，每次只传输一小部分数据。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Pagination splits a large result set into pages so each request transfers only a small slice.

q: 把基础商家搜索请求路径排成正确顺序。
q_en: Put the basic business search request path in the right order.
steps: Business Service 根据 query/location/category 查询商家数据
客户端发起 GET /businesses 请求
结果经 API Gateway 返回客户端
API Gateway 将请求路由到 Business Service
why: 基础路径是客户端到网关，网关到业务服务，业务服务查存储并返回。深挖前先有一条能工作的读路径。
why_en: The basic search path is client to API Gateway, then Business Service, then storage, and back to the client.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  A[Client] --> B[API Gateway]
  B --> C[Business Service]
  C --> D[(Business DB/Search Index)]
  D --> C
  C --> B
  B --> A

termDefinitions.meaning: 接收客户端请求并路由到具体后端服务的统一入口。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An API Gateway is the single entry point that routes client requests to the right backend service.

q: 基础高层设计中的主要组件有哪些？（多选）
q_en: Which components belong in the basic high-level Yelp design?
options: Client
API Gateway
Business Service
Video Transcoder
Database
options_en: Client — the web or mobile app.
API Gateway — routes requests to services.
Business Service — handles search and business reads.
Video Transcoder — a video-platform component, not part of Yelp.
Database — stores business and review data.
why: 基础读路径由客户端、网关、Business Service 和数据库组成；Video Transcoder 属于视频类系统。
why_en: The simple Yelp architecture uses a client, API Gateway, Business Service, and database.

termDefinitions.meaning: 接收客户端请求并路由到具体后端服务的统一入口。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An API Gateway is the single entry point that routes client requests to the right backend service.

scenario: 搜索商家和查看商家详情都读取相似的商家数据，读模式接近，且二者强相关。
scenario_en: Business search and business detail pages read similar business data, have similar read patterns, and are tightly related.
q: 这两块逻辑初始应该如何放置？
q_en: Where should search and business-detail logic live at the start?
options: 先放在同一个 Business Service 中
强行拆成两个微服务和两个数据库
全部放进 Review Service
放到客户端直接查数据库
options_en: Start with both inside one Business Service.
Force a split into two microservices with two databases.
Put everything inside the Review Service.
Let the client query the database directly.
tradeoff: 服务内聚的简单性 vs 提前拆分带来的独立扩缩容
why: 功能强相关且读扩展模式类似，先放一个服务能减少复杂度。服务边界应由职责和扩缩容差异驱动，而不是机械拆分。
why_en: Search and business detail reads are closely related and scale similarly, so one Business Service is the simpler starting boundary.
whenOtherWins: 如果详情页产生完全不同的热点、权限或写入路径，拆服务才更有理由。

termDefinitions.meaning: 职责单一、可独立部署和扩展的小型服务。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A microservice is a small, independently deployable service with a single responsibility.

scenario: 用户搜索和浏览很多，但很少写评论；评论创建有独立校验和写路径。
scenario_en: Users search and browse much more often than they write reviews; review creation has its own validation and write path.
q: 为什么引入单独的 Review Service 是合理的？
q_en: Why is a separate Review Service reasonable in this design?
options: 所有微服务都必须一服务一库
评论写入模式与商家读取模式差异大，可以独立演进
搜索必须通过 Review Service 才能低延迟
Review Service 可以替代数据库
options_en: Every microservice must own exactly one database.
Review writes have a very different pattern from business reads and can evolve independently.
Search must go through the Review Service to stay low-latency.
The Review Service can replace the database.
tradeoff: 写路径独立演进 vs 额外服务和数据同步成本
why: 写评论和读商家的流量形态不同，评论还要处理一人一评和评分更新。单独服务让写路径职责更清晰。
why_en: A Review Service is useful because review creation has a very different write-heavy workflow from business search and viewing.
whenOtherWins: 如果产品规模很小，一个服务内模块化就够；如果读写差异不明显，拆服务会增加无谓成本。
diagram:
flowchart LR
Client[Client] --> Biz[Business Service]
Client --> Review[Review Service]
Biz --> BizDB[(Business DB)]
Review --> ReviewDB[(Review DB)]
Review --> Rating[Rating aggregate]

scenario: Business 和 Review 紧密关联，详情页经常一起读取；总数据约 1TB 量级，单库或简单复制可承受。
scenario_en: Business and Review are tightly related and often read together; about one terabyte of data can fit in one database with replication.
q: 初始数据库边界更务实的选择是什么？
q_en: What is the pragmatic initial database boundary?
options: 评论正文必须存进 Redis
拆成两个服务各自独占数据库
先共用同一个数据库
商家数据必须存进对象存储
options_en: Review text must be stored in Redis.
Split into two services, each owning its own database.
Start with one shared database for both.
Business data must be stored in object storage.
tradeoff: 共库省 join 的简单性 vs 服务独立数据库带来的故障隔离
why: 两者紧密关联、总量约 1TB，先共库能避免跨服务 join；故障隔离可靠复制等手段先缓解。
why_en: Keeping businesses and reviews in one database is practical because they are tightly coupled and the data volume is manageable.
whenOtherWins: 如果评论写入量巨大、团队所有权强隔离或故障域要求严格，拆库才更值得。

termDefinitions.meaning: 以对象为单位存放非结构化数据的存储服务，如图片和文件。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Object storage holds unstructured data such as files and images as discrete objects.

scenario: 10M 商家、每家约 100 条评论，每条评论约 1KB，总评论数据量级约为 1TB。
scenario_en: Assume 10M businesses, about 100 reviews per business, and roughly 1KB per review, for about 1TB of review data.
q: 这个数据量级最支持下面哪条设计判断？
q_en: What design judgment does this data size support?
options: 写入量已经大到必须上消息队列
必须立刻做水平分片
应该把评论正文都放进内存缓存常驻
单库 + 简单复制就能撑住，不必现在做分片
options_en: Write volume is already too high without a message queue.
You must shard horizontally right away.
All review text should live permanently in an in-memory cache.
A single database with simple replication is enough; no need to shard yet.
why: 1TB 级别的数据现代单实例数据库可轻松承载，不需要为规模本身引入分片；故障隔离可靠复制缓解。
why_en: About one terabyte of review data comfortably fits a single modern database instance, so sharding is not yet needed for scale alone.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把数据水平切分到多个数据库实例，突破单机容量或吞吐上限。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Sharding splits data horizontally across multiple database instances to scale beyond one machine's limits.

q: 为什么不能在每次搜索时实时 join reviews 并计算平均评分？
q_en: Why should search not join reviews and compute average ratings on every request?
options: 评论越多，实时 join 聚合越慢，拖慢搜索
SQL 不能计算 AVG
平均评分不应该展示在搜索结果里
这样会违反一人一评约束
options_en: Real-time joins get slower as review counts grow, dragging down search reads.
SQL cannot compute AVG.
Average rating should not appear in search results.
This would violate the one-review-per-business rule.
why: 搜索是高频读路径，实时聚合会重复做相同计算，热门商家评论越多越慢；平均评分应预先或增量维护。
why_en: Computing average ratings during every search repeats expensive joins and aggregations on a high-read path.

termDefinitions.meaning: 关系型数据库中把两张表按条件关联起来的操作。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A JOIN combines rows from two database tables based on a related condition.

scenario: 商家详情页需要展示平均评分；候选方案是每次搜索都用下面这段 SQL 现算。
scenario_en: The business detail page needs average ratings, and one proposal computes them with this SQL on every search.
q: 这类实时平均评分 SQL 的主要扩展性问题是什么？
q_en: What is the main scalability problem with this real-time average-rating SQL?
codeSample:
SELECT b.business_id, b.name, AVG(r.rating) AS average_rating
FROM businesses b
JOIN reviews r ON b.business_id = r.business_id
GROUP BY b.business_id;
options: 它无法返回 business_id
每次读都重新 join 和聚合，评论越多越慢
它会自动保证一人一评
它会把数据写入 Elasticsearch
options_en: It cannot return business_id.
Every read repeats the join and aggregation, getting slower as reviews grow.
It automatically enforces one review per user.
It writes data into Elasticsearch.
why: 这段查询适合理解逻辑，不适合高频搜索路径：它把每次搜索都变成一次聚合计算，而不是读一个预计算字段。
why_en: The query is logically simple but makes every search pay for a join and aggregation instead of reading a maintained rating field.

termDefinitions.meaning: 关系型数据库中把两张表按条件关联起来的操作。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A JOIN combines rows from two database tables based on a related condition.

termDefinitions.meaning: 按某一列的值分组后再做聚合计算（如求平均）的 SQL 子句。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: GROUP BY is a SQL clause that groups rows by a column before applying an aggregate like AVG.

q: Write-Through 与 Write-Behind 在「写延迟 vs 持久性」上的区别是？
q_en: How do write-through and write-behind differ on write latency versus durability?
options: 写穿透写更快但可能丢数据
两者写延迟和持久性完全一样
同步落库写更慢但更持久，写回更快但可能丢
写回更慢也更持久，写穿透更快
options_en: Write-through is faster but may lose data.
Both have identical write latency and durability.
Write-through is slower but more durable; write-behind is faster but may lose data.
Write-behind is slower and more durable.
tradeoff: 写延迟 vs 数据持久性
why: Write-Through 同步落库→写慢但一写就持久；Write-Behind 异步落库→写快但崩溃可能丢。这是一条典型的「延迟 vs 持久性」权衡。
why_en: Write-through trades slower writes for durability, while write-behind trades possible data loss for much faster writes.

termDefinitions.meaning: 写入时同步更新缓存和数据库，两者都成功才算完成。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Write-through synchronously updates both the cache and the database before acknowledging a write.

termDefinitions.meaning: 写入先落到缓存，再由后台异步批量写入数据库。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Write-behind writes to the cache first and flushes to the database asynchronously in the background.

q: 补全增量更新平均评分所需的字段和公式：
q_en: Fill in the fields and formula needed for incremental average-rating updates.
text: Business 表保存 {{average_rating}} 和 {{num_reviews}}；新评分到来时，新均值 = {{(old_rating * num_reviews + new_rating) / (num_reviews + 1)}}。
why: 维护评论数后，每次新评论只需常数时间更新平均分。这个更新可以和写评论在同一事务或受保护的写路径中完成。
why_en: Keeping average_rating and num_reviews lets each new review update the average in constant time.

termDefinitions.meaning: 每次只根据新数据小幅调整已有聚合结果，而不重新计算整体。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An incremental update adjusts an existing aggregate slightly for each new data point instead of recomputing everything.

q: 两个用户同时基于同一个 num_reviews 和 average_rating 更新评分，可能导致什么问题？
q_en: What can go wrong if two users update the same rating aggregate from the same old state?
options: 评论文本会被压缩成图片
数据库自动转成全文搜索
搜索延迟一定下降
后写者覆盖先写者，最终平均分和评论数漏掉一条评论
options_en: Review text gets compressed into an image.
The database automatically switches to full-text search.
Search latency is guaranteed to drop.
The later writer overwrites the earlier one, so the final average and count miss a review.
why: 并发读旧状态后分别计算新均值，会产生 lost update。最终状态可能只反映其中一条评论，而不是两条。
why_en: Concurrent average-rating updates can cause a lost update when two writers calculate from the same old state.

termDefinitions.meaning: 两个并发写入基于同一旧状态计算，后写覆盖先写导致一次更新丢失。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A lost update happens when two concurrent writers compute from the same old state and one overwrites the other.

scenario: 写评论时需要同步更新商家的 num_reviews 和 average_rating；同一商家可能同时收到多条评论，但总体写量很小。
scenario_en: When writing a review, the system synchronously updates num_reviews and average_rating; the same business may receive concurrent reviews, but total write volume is small.
q: 避免评分并发丢更新，最合适的方式是什么？
q_en: What is the best way to avoid lost rating updates under concurrency?
options: 乐观锁：更新前校验版本未变，冲突就重试
把所有评分更新放进每天一次的离线任务
允许覆盖，因为最终一致总会自动修复
把平均分存在客户端
options_en: Optimistic locking: verify the version is unchanged before updating, retry on conflict.
Batch all rating updates into a once-a-day offline job.
Allow overwrites since eventual consistency will fix it automatically.
Store the average rating on the client.
tradeoff: 同步更新加重试的简单性 vs 引入队列的额外运维
why: 乐观锁失败时重新读取并重算，可以避免覆盖另一个并发评论。写量很小，因此同步更新加重试比引入队列更简单。
why_en: Optimistic locking detects concurrent changes to the rating row and retries from the latest state.
whenOtherWins: 如果同一商家写入极热、冲突频繁，异步聚合或分片计数器可能更好；本题写量太小，不必复杂化。
diagram:
flowchart LR
Review[New review] --> Tx[DB transaction]
Tx --> Insert[Insert review unique user business]
Tx --> Update[Atomic rating update]
Update --> Commit[Commit]

termDefinitions.meaning: 先记录读到的版本，更新时校验版本未变才写入，否则重试。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Optimistic locking checks that a record's version is unchanged before committing an update, retrying otherwise.

termDefinitions.meaning: 记录数据修改次数的字段，乐观锁靠它判断数据是否被并发修改。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A version field tracks how many times a row changed, letting optimistic locking detect concurrent edits.

scenario: 评论创建的读写比可达 1000:1，100M 日活用户下评论写入约为每秒 1 次。
scenario_en: Review creation can have a read-write ratio around 1000:1; at 100M daily active users, review writes are about one per second.
q: 这个写入量级最支持哪条设计判断？
q_en: What design judgment does this review-write volume support?
options: 写量已经超过数据库承载能力，必须分片
写量很小，同步更新 + 乐观锁足够，不必上消息队列
写量为零，可以完全不做并发控制
写量很大，必须引入消息队列削峰
options_en: Write volume already exceeds what the database can handle, so it must be sharded.
Write volume is tiny — synchronous updates with optimistic locking are enough, no queue needed.
Write volume is zero, so no concurrency control is needed.
Write volume is huge, so a message queue is required to absorb spikes.
why: 读写比约 1000:1，评论写入约 1/s，量级很小；用估算证明同步更新已经够用，是文章强调的 staff 信号。
why_en: With a read-write ratio around one thousand to one, review writes are roughly one per second — small enough that synchronous updates need no queue.

scenario: 候选人想在 Review Service 和评分更新之间加消息队列；但估算后评论写入只有约 1/s，数据库可轻松承受。
scenario_en: A candidate wants to add a message queue between Review Service and rating updates, but estimated review writes are only about one per second.
q: 更成熟的取舍是什么？
q_en: What is the more mature tradeoff for rating updates at this write volume?
options: 完全不存平均分
必须引入 Kafka，否则不是高级设计
同步写评论并更新平均分，用乐观锁保护并发
把评论写入浏览器 localStorage
options_en: Don't store the average rating at all.
You must introduce Kafka, or it isn't a sophisticated design.
Write reviews synchronously and update the average rating with optimistic locking.
Write reviews into browser localStorage.
optionMeanings: 彻底放弃维护评分字段。
引入 Kafka 做异步消息队列。
同步写入并用乐观锁防并发覆盖。
把评论数据放进浏览器本地存储。
tradeoff: 同步更新的简单性 vs 队列带来的额外一致性和运维成本
why: 低写量下，队列带来的最终一致和运维复杂度不值得。能用估算支持简单方案，是文章强调的 staff-level 信号。
why_en: With only about one review write per second, synchronous rating updates with optimistic locking are simpler than introducing a queue.
whenOtherWins: 如果评论写入达到数千每秒、同一商家冲突很高，异步队列和聚合服务才更有价值。

termDefinitions.meaning: 一个分布式消息队列/流平台，常用于削峰和异步处理。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Kafka is a distributed message queue and streaming platform used to smooth traffic spikes and decouple processing.

q: 只在应用层先查“用户是否已评论过”再写入，主要风险是什么？
q_en: What is the main risk of checking “has this user reviewed already” only in application code?
options: API Gateway 无法路由请求
数据库会拒绝所有合法评论
搜索索引会自动修复重复评论
其他写入路径或并发请求可能绕过检查，仍写出重复评论
options_en: The API Gateway cannot route the request.
The database will reject all legitimate reviews.
The search index will automatically fix duplicate reviews.
Other write paths or concurrent requests can bypass the check and still write a duplicate review.
why: 应用层检查不是全局约束，后续数据工程回填、其他服务或并发双击都可能绕过。数据不变量应尽量靠近持久层。
why_en: An application-layer check can be bypassed by other writers or races, so it cannot reliably enforce one review per user per business.

termDefinitions.meaning: 两个并发操作的执行顺序影响结果正确性时出现的问题。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A race condition occurs when the outcome depends on the unpredictable timing of concurrent operations.

scenario: 要强制每个 user_id 对同一个 business_id 只能插入一条 review，且所有写入路径都必须遵守。
scenario_en: The system must enforce that each user_id can insert only one review for the same business_id across all write paths.
q: 下面这个数据库约束解决了什么？
q_en: What does this database constraint enforce?
codeSample:
ALTER TABLE reviews
ADD CONSTRAINT unique_user_business UNIQUE (user_id, business_id);
options: 在数据库层强制一人一商家一评
把评论平均分缓存到 Redis
创建地理空间索引
把评论自动同步到 Elasticsearch
options_en: Enforce one review per user per business at the database layer.
Cache the average rating in Redis.
Create a geospatial index.
Automatically sync reviews to Elasticsearch.
tradeoff: 数据库层强约束覆盖所有写入者 vs 应用层检查的简单但可绕过
why: 唯一约束由数据库引擎执行，无论哪个服务写入都不能插入重复 user/business 组合。第二个并发写会失败，应用只需优雅返回错误。
why_en: The unique constraint enforces one review per user per business at the database layer for every writer.
whenOtherWins: 如果规则是软约束或需要保留多次编辑历史，可以改成 review revision 模型；但唯一有效评论仍应有数据库约束。

termDefinitions.meaning: 数据库层的唯一性约束，拒绝插入违反指定列组合唯一性的记录。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A unique constraint is a database rule that rejects inserts violating uniqueness on the specified columns.

q: 补全数据约束的设计原则：
q_en: Fill in the design principle for enforcing data constraints.
text: 越核心的数据不变量，越应该在靠近{{持久层}}的位置强制，而不是只依赖{{应用层}} if 检查。
why: 数据库约束能覆盖多服务、脚本、回填和并发请求。应用层仍要做用户友好的错误处理，但不应是唯一防线。
why_en: Core data invariants should be enforced near persistence rather than only with application-level checks.

termDefinitions.meaning: 系统任何时候都必须成立的数据规则，例如一人一商家一评。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A data invariant is a rule that must always hold, such as one review per user per business.

scenario: 商家搜索需要同时按经纬度范围和名称通配过滤，数据量已到 10M 商家。
scenario_en: Business search must filter by latitude-longitude range and wildcard name matching, with data already at 10M businesses.
q: 这类朴素商家搜索 SQL 在大数据量下最主要的问题是什么？
q_en: What is the main problem with this naive business-search SQL at large scale?
codeSample:
SELECT *
FROM businesses
WHERE latitude > 10 AND latitude < 20
  AND longitude > 10 AND longitude < 20
  AND name LIKE '%coffee%';
options: SQL 不能比较数字
经纬度范围和通配文本搜索会导致低效扫描
LIKE 一定能用普通 B-tree 完美加速
它会自动按距离排序
options_en: SQL cannot compare numbers.
Latitude/longitude range plus wildcard text search causes inefficient scanning.
LIKE is always perfectly accelerated by a plain B-tree.
It automatically sorts by distance.
why: 二维地理范围和中缀文本匹配都不是普通表扫描擅长的模式。10M 商家下，需要专门索引结构。
why_en: Naive latitude-longitude ranges and wildcard text matching are inefficient at scale without specialized indexes.

termDefinitions.meaning: SQL 中做模糊字符串匹配的操作符，带通配符时无法高效使用普通索引。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: LIKE is a SQL operator for pattern matching text; wildcard patterns cannot use a plain index efficiently.

termDefinitions.meaning: 关系型数据库最常见的一维有序索引，适合单列范围查询。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A B-tree is the common one-dimensional ordered index in relational databases, suited to single-column range queries.

q: 为什么简单 B-tree 复合索引不适合经纬度范围搜索？
q_en: Why is a simple compound B-tree a poor fit for latitude-longitude range search?
options: B-tree 只能用于写入不能用于读取
B-tree 只能存字符串
B-tree 不理解二维空间关系，对多维范围查询效果差
B-tree 会自动忽略 latitude
options_en: A B-tree can only be used for writes, not reads.
A B-tree can only store strings.
A B-tree does not understand 2D spatial relationships, so it performs poorly on multi-dimensional range queries.
A B-tree automatically ignores latitude.
tradeoff: 一维有序范围查询 vs 二维空间邻近查询
why: B-tree 擅长一维有序范围，不擅长表达点在二维区域中的空间邻近。地理搜索更适合 geohash、quadtree、R-tree 或 PostGIS/ES 的空间索引。
why_en: A B-tree orders values one-dimensionally and does not model the spatial relationships needed for efficient two-dimensional geo queries.

termDefinitions.meaning: 关系型数据库最常见的一维有序索引，适合单列范围查询。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A B-tree is the common one-dimensional ordered index in relational databases, suited to single-column range queries.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把经纬度编码成字符串前缀的地理索引，前缀越长区域越精确。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Geohash encodes latitude and longitude into a string prefix, where longer prefixes mean smaller regions.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把二维空间递归四等分的树形地理索引，能按密度自适应划分。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A quadtree recursively splits 2D space into four quadrants, adapting to point density.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用外接矩形组织空间对象的树形索引，是数据库常见的原生空间索引。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An R-tree indexes spatial objects with bounding rectangles and is a common native database spatial index.

q: 按搜索过滤维度，需要哪些索引策略？（多选）
q_en: Which indexing strategies are needed for the different Yelp search filters?
options: 位置搜索需要 geohash、quadtree、R-tree 等地理空间索引
所有过滤都只能靠全表扫描
类别过滤可以用简单 B-tree / keyword 索引
名称搜索需要倒排索引支持全文搜索
options_en: Location search needs a geospatial index such as geohash, quadtree, or R-tree.
All filtering can only rely on full table scans.
Category filtering can use a simple B-tree or keyword index.
Name search needs an inverted index for full-text search.
why: Yelp 搜索同时有位置、文本和类别三个性质不同的过滤器。一个索引形态无法优雅解决所有维度。
why_en: Yelp search combines geo, full-text, and category filters, each needing a different indexing strategy.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把经纬度编码成字符串前缀的地理索引，前缀越长区域越精确。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Geohash encodes latitude and longitude into a string prefix, where longer prefixes mean smaller regions.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把二维空间递归四等分的树形地理索引，能按密度自适应划分。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A quadtree recursively splits 2D space into four quadrants, adapting to point density.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用外接矩形组织空间对象的树形索引，是数据库常见的原生空间索引。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An R-tree indexes spatial objects with bounding rectangles and is a common native database spatial index.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把词映射到包含该词的文档列表的索引结构，是全文搜索的核心。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An inverted index maps each term to the documents containing it, powering full-text search.

termDefinitions.meaning: 关系型数据库最常见的一维有序索引，适合单列范围查询。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A B-tree is the common one-dimensional ordered index in relational databases, suited to single-column range queries.

scenario: 搜索需要在一个查询里组合名称全文匹配、10km 范围内的位置过滤、类别过滤，并返回相关性排序结果。
scenario_en: Search must combine full-text name matching, a 10km location filter, category filtering, and ranked results in one query.
q: 最直接匹配这些需求的技术是什么？
q_en: Which technology most directly matches these combined search requirements?
options: 单列 B-tree 索引
S3
Redis Pub/Sub
Elasticsearch
options_en: A single-column B-tree index.
Redis Pub/Sub.
Elasticsearch.
tradeoff: 多条件组合搜索能力 vs 引入派生系统的一致性成本
why: Elasticsearch 原生支持倒排索引、地理过滤和 keyword 过滤，很适合多条件搜索。它让 Business Service 发起一个组合查询得到排序结果。
why_en: Elasticsearch is built for combined full-text, geo, and keyword filtering with ranked search results.
whenOtherWins: 如果数据量不大且想减少运维组件，Postgres + PostGIS + pg_trgm 可能更简单；ES 不应作为事务主库。
diagram:
flowchart LR
Query[Search query] --> ES[(Elasticsearch)]
ES --> Geo[Geo filter]
ES --> Text[Text match]
ES --> Rank[Rank results]
Rank --> API[Search API]

termDefinitions.meaning: 基于倒排索引的搜索引擎，擅长全文、地理和多条件组合查询。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Elasticsearch is a search engine built on inverted indexes, strong at full-text, geo, and multi-filter queries.

termDefinitions.meaning: 对象存储服务，适合存文件和二进制大对象，不是搜索索引。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: S3 is an object storage service suited to files and blobs, not search indexing.

termDefinitions.meaning: Redis 提供的发布订阅消息机制，不是持久化搜索索引。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Redis Pub/Sub is a publish-subscribe messaging feature, not a persistent search index.

termDefinitions.meaning: 关系型数据库最常见的一维有序索引，适合单列范围查询。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A B-tree is the common one-dimensional ordered index in relational databases, suited to single-column range queries.

scenario: 用户搜索纽约附近 10km 内类别为 coffee shop 且名称匹配 coffee 的商家。
scenario_en: A user searches for coffee shops matching “coffee” within 10km of New York.
q: 这段 Elasticsearch 查询体现了什么能力？
q_en: What capability does this Elasticsearch query demonstrate?
options: 在一个搜索查询里组合全文、地理距离和类别过滤
在数据库层强制一人一评
计算所有评论的平均分
执行视频转码 DAG
options_en: Combine full-text, geo-distance, and category filtering in one search query.
Enforce one review per user at the database layer.
Compute the average of all ratings.
Run a video-transcoding DAG.
tradeoff: 单次组合查询覆盖多条件 vs 多次简单查询拼接
why: bool 查询把名称 match、geo_distance 和 category term 合在一起，是 Yelp 搜索的核心形态。Business DB 仍保留事务真相。
why_en: The query combines full-text matching, geo-distance filtering, and category filtering in one search request.
whenOtherWins: 如果只按 business_id 点查详情，主数据库比 ES 更合适；如果只做简单类别过滤，普通数据库索引也够。

termDefinitions.meaning: Elasticsearch 中组合多个查询条件（must/should/filter）的查询结构。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A bool query combines multiple conditions such as must, should, and filter clauses in Elasticsearch.

termDefinitions.meaning: Elasticsearch 中按到某个点的距离过滤文档的查询类型。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: geo_distance is an Elasticsearch query type that filters documents by distance from a point.

q: 为什么 Elasticsearch 不应该成为 Yelp 的主事务数据库？
q_en: Why should Elasticsearch not be Yelp’s primary transactional database?
options: 它不能做任何搜索
它不是强 ACID 事务系统
它不能存 JSON 文档
它只能处理图片
options_en: It cannot search at all.
It is not a strong-ACID transactional system.
It cannot store JSON documents.
It can only process images.
why: ES 强在搜索和分析，不是事务真相源。主数据库负责约束、事务和持久数据完整性，ES 作为派生索引。
why_en: Elasticsearch is a search index, not the transactional source of truth for ACID constraints and data integrity.

termDefinitions.meaning: 全称 Atomicity, Consistency, Isolation, Durability：数据库事务保证的四个特性。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: ACID, short for Atomicity, Consistency, Isolation, and Durability, describes a database transaction's guarantees.

scenario: 主数据库是商家和评论的真相源，但搜索请求读 Elasticsearch；商家名称、类别、评分更新后需要同步到搜索索引。
scenario_en: The primary database is the source of truth for businesses and reviews, but search reads Elasticsearch; name, category, and rating changes must sync to the search index.
q: 更合适的数据同步方式是什么？
q_en: What is the better way to sync primary-database changes into Elasticsearch?
options: 让客户端同时写主库和 ES
每天手动复制 CSV
CDC 捕获主库变更，消费者同步更新 ES
从搜索请求里反向更新主库
options_en: Have the client write to both the primary database and Elasticsearch at once.
Manually copy a CSV file once a day.
CDC captures primary-database changes and a consumer syncs them into Elasticsearch.
Update the primary database backward from search requests.
tradeoff: 事件流保持最终一致 vs 客户端双写的不一致风险
why: CDC 把主库变更转成事件流，消费者把同样变更应用到 ES，保持派生索引最终一致。客户端双写更容易出现不一致。
why_en: CDC streams primary-database changes to consumers that update Elasticsearch, keeping the search index eventually consistent.
whenOtherWins: 如果搜索数据允许长时间陈旧，定时批量重建更简单；如果必须强一致搜索，ES 派生索引本身就不合适。
diagram:
flowchart LR
Postgres[(Primary DB)] --> CDC[CDC stream]
CDC --> Indexer[Indexer]
Indexer --> ES[(Search index)]
ES --> Search[Search Service]

termDefinitions.meaning: 全称 Change Data Capture：捕获数据库变更并作为事件流转发给下游消费者。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: CDC, short for Change Data Capture, streams database changes to downstream consumers as events.

scenario: 系统只有 10M 商家和约 1TB 评论，希望避免引入 Elasticsearch 的运维和一致性成本，同时仍支持地理和文本搜索。
scenario_en: The system has only 10M businesses and about 1TB of reviews, and you want to avoid Elasticsearch’s operational and consistency cost while still supporting geo and text search.

q_en: At Yelp’s 10M-business scale, what simpler alternative avoids Elasticsearch?
options: 只使用普通 LIKE 和无索引经纬度查询
S3 + CDN
Redis Pub/Sub + 本地文件
Postgres + PostGIS + pg_trgm
options_en: Plain LIKE queries with no index on latitude/longitude.
S3 plus a CDN.
Redis Pub/Sub plus local files.
Postgres with the PostGIS and pg_trgm extensions.

why: PostGIS 支持地理查询，pg_trgm 支持文本相似/全文相关能力，数据量也不大。这个选择牺牲一些超大规模搜索能力，换取架构简单。
why_en: Postgres with PostGIS and pg_trgm can handle geo and text search while avoiding a separate Elasticsearch consistency pipeline.
whenOtherWins: 当全文搜索规模、相关性调优或搜索吞吐远超 Postgres 能力时，ES 更合适。

termDefinitions.meaning: Postgres 的地理空间扩展，为经纬度和多边形数据提供索引与查询能力。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: PostGIS is a Postgres extension that adds geospatial indexing and query capabilities.

termDefinitions.meaningEn: pg_trgm is a Postgres extension that speeds up fuzzy text matching using trigrams.

q: 下面这些 Postgres 扩展分别用于什么方向？
q_en: What are these Postgres extensions used for?
codeSample:
CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS postgis;
CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pg_trgm;
options: PostGIS 管地理查询，pg_trgm 管文本相似匹配
PostGIS 管消息队列，pg_trgm 管对象存储
二者都只用于视频转码
二者都用于限制每人一评
options_en: PostGIS handles geo queries; pg_trgm handles fuzzy text matching.
PostGIS handles message queues; pg_trgm handles object storage.
Both are only used for video transcoding.
Both are used to enforce one review per user.
why: PostGIS 给 Postgres 增加空间数据类型和索引，pg_trgm 帮助文本相似匹配。它们让单个数据库覆盖 Yelp 的关键搜索需求。
why_en: PostGIS adds geospatial querying and pg_trgm supports text matching inside Postgres.

termDefinitions.meaning: Postgres 的地理空间扩展，为经纬度和多边形数据提供索引与查询能力。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: PostGIS is a Postgres extension that adds geospatial indexing and query capabilities.

termDefinitions.meaning: Postgres 的文本相似度扩展，用三元组加速模糊文本匹配。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: pg_trgm is a Postgres extension that speeds up fuzzy text matching using trigrams.

q: 在 Yelp 文章的语境里，Postgres 扩展方案相比 Elasticsearch 的主要优势是什么？
q_en: In the Yelp design, what is the main advantage of Postgres extensions over Elasticsearch?

少一个派生搜索系统，降低一致性和运维复杂度
不需要任何索引
可以替代 Review Service
options_en: It is always stronger than Elasticsearch at full-text search.
One fewer derived search system, lowering consistency and ops complexity.

why: Postgres 方案把真相源和搜索能力放在同一系统内，避免 CDC 和 ES 运维。代价是超大规模全文搜索能力可能不如 ES。
why_en: The Postgres-extension approach reduces operational and consistency complexity by avoiding a separate derived search system.

scenario_en: The interviewer disallows Elasticsearch and asks for a geo-index strategy; businesses change rarely and cluster heavily in dense city areas.

Quadtree

Quadtree.
Put lat/long into Redis Pub/Sub.
tradeoff: 自适应密集区域划分（quadtree）vs 简单字符串前缀（geohash）
why: 文章认为商家更新很少且分布在密集城市区域，quadtree 能更自然地细分高密度区域。geohash 也可讨论，但要说出取舍。
why_en: A quadtree is attractive because businesses change infrequently and cluster densely in urban regions.
whenOtherWins: 如果希望字符串前缀索引简单、工程实现更统一，geohash 也可胜出；R-tree 则适合数据库原生空间索引。

termDefinitions.meaning: 把二维空间递归四等分的树形地理索引，能按密度自适应划分。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A quadtree recursively splits 2D space into four quadrants, adapting to point density.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把经纬度编码成字符串前缀的地理索引，前缀越长区域越精确。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Geohash encodes latitude and longitude into a string prefix, where longer prefixes mean smaller regions.

termDefinitions.meaning: 关系型数据库最常见的一维有序索引，适合单列范围查询。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A B-tree is the common one-dimensional ordered index in relational databases, suited to single-column range queries.

q: 地理索引先粗筛后，为什么还需要 second-pass filtering？
q_en: Why does geo search still need second-pass filtering after a coarse geo index?
options: 评分平均值只能第二遍计算
数据库不能存经纬度
全文搜索会自动删除类别
粗筛区域可能包含半径外的点，需要用精确距离再过滤
options_en: Average rating can only be computed on the second pass.
The database cannot store latitude and longitude.
Full-text search automatically deletes category.
The coarse filter can include points outside the radius, so exact distance must filter again.
why: geohash、quadtree 或 bounding box 通常先返回候选区域，里面可能有离用户太远的商家。第二遍用实际距离计算过滤出真实半径内结果。
why_en: Second-pass filtering computes exact distance after the geo index produces a coarse candidate set.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用经纬度计算球面上两点间距离的公式，用于地理搜索的精确过滤。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The Haversine formula computes the distance between two latitude-longitude points on a sphere.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用经纬度矩形范围粗筛地理数据的一种简单查询方式。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A bounding box is a rectangular lat/long range used for a coarse first-pass geo filter.

q: 常用于经纬度两点间球面距离计算的公式叫什么？
q_en: What formula is commonly used to compute spherical distance between two lat/long points?
options: Haversine 公式
CAP 定理
Raft 选举公式
LRU 公式
options_en: The Haversine formula.
The CAP theorem.
The Raft leader-election algorithm.
The LRU formula.
why: Haversine 用于球面上两点距离，适合经纬度精确距离过滤。面试不一定要推公式，但要知道第二遍过滤的概念。
why_en: The Haversine formula is commonly used to compute exact distance between latitude-longitude points on a sphere.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用经纬度计算球面上两点间距离的公式，用于地理搜索的精确过滤。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The Haversine formula computes the distance between two latitude-longitude points on a sphere.

termDefinitions.meaning: 全称 Consistency, Availability, Partition tolerance：网络分区时只能在一致性和可用性间二选一。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The CAP theorem says a distributed system can guarantee only two of consistency, availability, and partition tolerance during a network split.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一种分布式共识算法，用于在多个节点间选主并保持日志一致。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Raft is a distributed consensus algorithm used to elect a leader and keep logs consistent across nodes.

termDefinitions.meaning: 全称 Least Recently Used：优先淘汰最久未访问数据的缓存策略。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: LRU, short for Least Recently Used, is a cache eviction policy that removes the least recently accessed item first.

q: 如果不用 Elasticsearch，把多条件搜索的阶段排成更合理顺序。
q_en: Without Elasticsearch, put the multi-filter search stages in a better order.
steps: 在较小候选集上应用名称和类别过滤
用地理索引按位置先缩小候选集合
用精确距离计算剔除半径外商家
返回排序后的分页结果
tradeoff: 先用最具选择性的地理过滤缩小候选集 vs 先做文本/类别过滤
why: 位置通常最能缩小搜索空间，应先做粗筛和精确距离过滤。随后再在小集合上做名称、类别和排序，读路径更高效。
whenOtherWins: 如果位置过滤选择性很低、文本关键词更稀疏，可以先用文本索引缩小候选集；顺序应由选择性决定。
why_en: Apply the most selective geo filter first, refine by exact distance, then apply text and category filters on the smaller candidate set.
diagram:
flowchart TD
Query[User query] --> Geo[Geo coarse filter]
Geo --> Text[Text or category filter]
Text --> Distance[Exact distance]
Distance --> Rank[Rank and paginate]

termDefinitions.meaning: 经过初步过滤后剩下的、还需要进一步筛选的结果子集。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A candidate set is the subset of results remaining after a coarse filter, still needing further filtering.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用经纬度矩形范围粗筛地理数据的一种简单查询方式。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A bounding box is a rectangular lat/long range used for a coarse first-pass geo filter.

q: 为什么用“某个中心点 + 固定半径”不能很好支持城市或街区名称搜索？
q_en: Why does “one center point plus fixed radius” fail for city or neighborhood search?
options: 城市名称不能被数据库存储
城市和街区边界通常是不规则多边形，不是完美圆形
半径搜索一定比多边形搜索强一致
经纬度只能表示国家
options_en: City names cannot be stored in a database.
City and neighborhood boundaries are usually irregular polygons, not perfect circles.
Radius search is always more strongly consistent than polygon search.
Latitude and longitude can only represent countries.
tradeoff: 固定半径的简单性 vs 多边形边界的准确性
why: 自然语言位置如城市、社区、街区往往是不规则边界。用圆形会包含边界外商家或漏掉边界内商家。
why_en: Named places like cities and neighborhoods are irregular polygons, not circles around a single center point.

termDefinitions.meaning: 由多个点连成的封闭图形，用来精确表示不规则地理边界。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A polygon is a closed shape made of connected points, used to represent irregular geographic boundaries.

scenario: 用户输入 Pizza in The Mission；系统需要把自然语言地点名转换为可用于地理过滤的边界。
scenario_en: A user types “Pizza in The Mission”; the system must turn the named place into a boundary that can drive geo filtering.
q: 地点名搜索的第一步应该建模什么？
q_en: For named-place search, what should the system model first?
options: 把所有城市映射成同一个中心点
只把 The Mission 当作 category
建 locations 表映射地名到多边形
要求用户必须输入经纬度
options_en: Map every city to the same center point.
Treat 'The Mission' as just a category.
Build a locations table mapping place names to polygons.
Require users to always enter raw lat/long.
tradeoff: 地名转多边形的建模成本 vs 直接要求用户提供坐标
why: locations 表把城市、社区等名字映射到多边形边界，可来自 GeoJSON 或公开地理数据源。这样系统能先解析位置名，再做空间过滤。
why_en: A locations table maps place names and types to polygon boundaries for later spatial filtering.
whenOtherWins: 如果只支持邮编或城市中心附近搜索，中心点和半径可能够用；复杂街区边界需要多边形。

termDefinitions.meaning: 一种用 JSON 描述点、线、多边形等地理形状的通用数据格式。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: GeoJSON is a common JSON-based format for representing geographic shapes such as points and polygons.

termDefinitions.meaning: 由多个点连成的封闭图形，用来精确表示不规则地理边界。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A polygon is a closed shape made of connected points, used to represent irregular geographic boundaries.

q: GeoJSON 这类数据在 Yelp 地点名搜索中主要用于什么？
q_en: What is GeoJSON mainly used for in Yelp named-location search?
options: 发送 API Gateway 路由规则
存储评论文本压缩结果
实现一人一评唯一约束
表示城市、街区等地点的多边形坐标
options_en: Sending API Gateway routing rules.
Storing compressed review text.
Enforcing the one-review-per-business constraint.
Representing polygon coordinates for places like cities and neighborhoods.
why: GeoJSON 常用于描述地理形状和坐标集合。它可以作为 locations 表多边形数据的来源或交换格式。
why_en: GeoJSON can represent the polygon coordinates for named places such as cities and neighborhoods.

termDefinitions.meaning: 一种用 JSON 描述点、线、多边形等地理形状的通用数据格式。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: GeoJSON is a common JSON-based format for representing geographic shapes such as points and polygons.

scenario: 系统已经拿到某个城市或街区的 polygon，需要找出落在这个区域内的商家。
scenario_en: The system already has a polygon for a city or neighborhood and needs to find businesses inside that area.
q: 按 polygon 过滤商家时，哪些系统能力适合直接支持？
q_en: Which system capabilities can directly filter businesses by a polygon?
options: PostGIS 或 Elasticsearch 的空间形状查询
Redis Pub/Sub
S3 lifecycle policy
普通字符串前缀匹配 business_id
options_en: PostGIS or Elasticsearch spatial-shape queries.
Redis Pub/Sub.
An S3 lifecycle policy.
Plain string-prefix matching on business_id.
tradeoff: 原生空间形状查询能力 vs 字符串匹配的表达力不足
why: PostGIS 和 Elasticsearch 都有空间查询能力，可判断点是否落在形状内或进行边界过滤。普通字符串匹配无法理解几何关系。
why_en: PostGIS and Elasticsearch geo capabilities can filter businesses by whether their points fall inside a polygon.
whenOtherWins: 如果地点集合很少且业务只需近似结果，预计算 location_names 会比每次做形状查询更快。

termDefinitions.meaning: Postgres 的地理空间扩展，为经纬度和多边形数据提供索引与查询能力。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: PostGIS is a Postgres extension that adds geospatial indexing and query capabilities.

termDefinitions.meaning: Elasticsearch 中分别表示复杂几何形状和单点坐标的字段类型。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: geo_shape and geo_point are Elasticsearch field types for complex geometries and single coordinates.

termDefinitions.meaning: 基于倒排索引的搜索引擎，擅长全文、地理和多条件组合查询。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Elasticsearch is a search engine built on inverted indexes, strong at full-text, geo, and multi-filter queries.

q: 为什么每次请求都对 polygon 或 bounding box 做实时空间过滤不够理想？
q_en: Why is real-time polygon or bounding-box filtering on every request not ideal?
options: 它会让用户无法写评论
重复计算多，热门地点会反复做相同判断
它一定违反 GDPR
它无法返回任何商家
options_en: It would make users unable to write reviews.
It repeats the same computation for popular locations on every request.
It always violates GDPR.
It cannot return any businesses.
why: 地点名搜索会反复命中相同城市和街区，实时空间判断会重复消耗查询资源。商家创建或更新位置时预计算可减少读路径成本。
why_en: Doing polygon filtering on every request repeats the same spatial work for popular named locations.

termDefinitions.meaning: 全称 General Data Protection Regulation：欧盟的数据隐私保护法规。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: GDPR, short for General Data Protection Regulation, is the EU's data privacy law.

scenario: 商家位置更新非常少，读请求很多；想让 Pizza in NYC 这类地点名过滤走简单快速的倒排索引。
scenario_en: Business locations change rarely, reads are frequent, and “Pizza in NYC” should use a simple fast inverted-index filter.
q: 读多写少的地点名搜索，更好的优化是什么？
q_en: For read-heavy named-place search, what optimization works better?
options: 取消地点名搜索
每次查询都全表扫描所有 polygon
建商家时预计算 location_names
把地点名写进 review text
options_en: Remove named-location search entirely.
Full-scan every polygon on every query.
Precompute location_names when the business is created.
Write the place name into the review text.
tradeoff: 写时预计算换读路径快 vs 商家位置变化时要重新计算
why: 写少读多时，把商家所属区域预计算成 location_names，读路径只需 keyword / inverted index 过滤。它把空间计算从请求时转移到写入时。
why_en: Precomputing location_names shifts expensive spatial containment work from the read path to rare business creation or update time.
whenOtherWins: 如果商家位置频繁变化或地点边界经常更新，实时空间查询可能更容易保持正确。
diagram:
flowchart LR
Place[City polygon] --> Precompute[Precompute location names]
Precompute --> Doc[Business search doc]
Doc --> Index[(Search index)]
Index --> Query[Place name query]

termDefinitions.meaning: Elasticsearch 中按精确值匹配（不分词）的字段类型，适合做标签过滤。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A keyword field in Elasticsearch matches exact values without tokenizing, good for tag-style filters.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把词映射到包含该词的文档列表的索引结构，是全文搜索的核心。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An inverted index maps each term to the documents containing it, powering full-text search.

scenario: 商家搜索需要按 Pizza in San Francisco 这类地名过滤，且要求读路径足够快。
scenario_en: Business search needs to filter by named places such as “Pizza in San Francisco,” and the read path must stay fast.
q: 这个商家文档里的 location_names 字段如何帮助地点名搜索？
q_en: How does the location_names field help named-location search?
options: 用来替代 business_id 主键
用来计算用户是否只能留一条评论
用来存储视频片段清单
用 keyword 倒排索引按城市/街区过滤商家
options_en: It replaces the business_id primary key.
It checks whether a user has already left one review.
It stores a list of video segments.
A keyword inverted index filters businesses by city or neighborhood quickly.
why: location_names 把空间归属变成离散标签，搜索时可像类别一样过滤。代价是写入时要预计算并维护这些标签。
why_en: The location_names field turns polygon membership into indexed keywords for fast named-location filtering.

termDefinitions.meaning: Elasticsearch 中按精确值匹配（不分词）的字段类型，适合做标签过滤。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A keyword field in Elasticsearch matches exact values without tokenizing, good for tag-style filters.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把词映射到包含该词的文档列表的索引结构，是全文搜索的核心。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An inverted index maps each term to the documents containing it, powering full-text search.

q: 把 Yelp 搜索能力的决策链排成正确顺序。
q_en: Put the Yelp search-capability decision chain in the right order.
steps: 如果用 ES，需要通过 CDC 从主库同步派生索引
识别搜索同时包含位置、名称和类别三类过滤
如果数据量和运维压力允许，也可用 Postgres 扩展避免 ES
为三类过滤选择空间索引、倒排索引和类别索引
避免用无索引经纬度范围和 LIKE 扫全表
tradeoff: 接受 Elasticsearch 的一致性成本 vs 用 Postgres 扩展换运维简单
why: 先理解过滤维度，再识别朴素查询问题并选择索引；ES 是强搜索方案但带一致性成本，Postgres 扩展是简化替代。这个链条比只背一个技术名更有说服力。
whenOtherWins: 如果团队已强依赖 Elasticsearch 或搜索相关性很复杂，ES 路线可以更早成为主方案；小规模时 Postgres 扩展可先胜出。
why_en: A strong search design starts from the filter dimensions, chooses the right indexes, then weighs Elasticsearch against simpler Postgres extensions.
diagram:
flowchart TD
  A[Name + location + category] --> B[Naive query too slow]
  B --> C[Geo + inverted + category indexes]
  C --> D[Elasticsearch + CDC]
  C --> E[Postgres extensions]

termDefinitions.meaning: 全称 Change Data Capture：捕获数据库变更并作为事件流转发给下游消费者。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: CDC, short for Change Data Capture, streams database changes to downstream consumers as events.

q: Staff-level Yelp 设计最关键的信号是什么？
q_en: What is the key staff-level signal in a Yelp system design answer?
options: 能识别简单方案足够的地方，并说明复杂方案何时才必要
无论规模都必须引入所有中间件
只画高层图，不做任何取舍
避免讨论搜索索引
options_en: Recognizing where a simple design suffices, and explaining when the complex alternative becomes necessary.
Introducing every piece of middleware regardless of scale.
Only drawing the high-level diagram with no tradeoffs.
Avoiding any discussion of search indexes.
why: staff 候选人要能用写量、数据量和一致性需求支持“少引入组件”的选择，同时知道复杂方案的边界。简单不是偷懒，而是被约束证明过的简单。
why_en: The staff-level signal is recognizing when a simple design is sufficient and explaining when the more complex alternative becomes necessary.

q: Yelp 题中高级候选人应能深入讨论哪些主题？（多选）
q_en: Which deep-dive topics should a senior Yelp candidate be able to discuss?
options: 平均评分的实时维护和并发控制
一人一评约束应靠数据库唯一约束
视频 adaptive bitrate streaming
位置、名称、类别搜索需要不同索引
options_en: Real-time average rating maintenance and concurrency control.
The one-review-per-business rule should be a database constraint.
Video adaptive bitrate streaming.
Location, name, and category search need different indexes.
why: Yelp 深挖主要围绕评分、评论约束和搜索索引。adaptive bitrate streaming 属于 YouTube 题。
why_en: Strong Yelp answers cover rating maintenance, database-enforced review constraints, and the right search indexes.

scenario: 商家搜索和详情读取远多于写入，热门商家和热门搜索会带来大量重复读。
scenario_en: Business search and detail reads are far more frequent than writes, and hot businesses or hot searches create many repeated reads.
q: 在基础设计之外，读扩展的自然补强是什么？
q_en: Beyond the basic design, what is the natural read-scaling addition?
options: 把每个搜索请求都写入主库
读副本和缓存，尤其缓存热门商家详情或搜索结果片段
取消平均评分字段
让 Review Service 处理所有读请求
options_en: Write every search request into the primary database.
Read replicas and caching, especially for hot business details or search-result fragments.
Remove the average rating field.
Let the Review Service handle all reads.
tradeoff: 读副本/缓存分担主库压力 vs 陈旧读的一致性代价
why: Yelp 是典型读多写少系统，读副本和缓存可以减轻主库压力。搜索本身还需要专用索引或搜索引擎来降低查询成本。
why_en: Because Yelp is read-heavy, replicas and caches naturally reduce load on the primary store for hot business reads.
whenOtherWins: 如果数据必须强一致且写后立刻读不能陈旧，缓存和副本需要 read-your-writes 或短 TTL；小规模系统可先不加。

termDefinitions.meaning: 从主数据库异步复制数据的只读实例，用来分担读流量。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A read replica is a read-only copy that asynchronously receives data from the primary database to offload reads.

q: Yelp 搜索结果接受 eventual consistency 的含义是什么？
q_en: What does accepting eventual consistency for Yelp search results mean?
options: 用户永远不能看到自己的评论
数据库可以永久丢失评论
评论可能稍晚才出现在搜索里，但服务保持可用
搜索必须等待所有副本同步后才能返回
options_en: Users can never see their own review.
The database is allowed to permanently lose reviews.
A new review may show up in search a bit later, but the service stays available.
Search must wait for every replica to sync before returning.
tradeoff: 可用性与低延迟 vs 读到最新数据的强一致性
why: 对本地商家搜索来说，短暂陈旧通常可接受，换取更高可用性和更快响应。关键约束如一人一评仍应在主数据库中保证。
why_en: Eventual consistency means search may briefly show stale ratings or reviews while preserving availability and latency.

termDefinitions.meaning: 写入后短时间内副本可能不一致，但停止写入后会收敛到相同状态。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Eventual consistency means replicas may briefly disagree after a write but converge once writes stop.

scenario: 需要给出最终 Yelp 设计：低延迟搜索、高可用、10M 商家、一人一评、评分随评论更新。
scenario_en: The final Yelp design must support low-latency search, high availability, 10M businesses, one review per user per business, and rating updates when reviews are written.
q: 哪组组件和策略最贴合文章最终方向？
q_en: Which component and strategy set best matches the final Yelp design direction?
options: 只用对象存储保存所有结构化数据
单服务 + 全表扫描 + 应用层去重
只用 Elasticsearch 作为唯一主库
服务分离 + DB 约束 + 增量评分 + 合适搜索索引
options_en: Use object storage alone for all structured data.
One monolithic service with full table scans and application-layer dedup.
Use Elasticsearch alone as the only primary database.
Separate services, database constraints, incremental ratings, and the right search index.
tradeoff: 职责分离但不过度拆分 vs 单体简单但难以独立扩展
why: 最终设计把职责分开但不过度拆分，用数据库保证核心约束，用增量字段支持评分读取，用合适索引支持搜索。技术选择可在 ES 和 Postgres 扩展之间按复杂度取舍。
why_en: The final design combines clear services, database-enforced constraints, incremental rating maintenance, and purpose-built search indexing.
whenOtherWins: 极小规模 demo 可以先用单服务和简单 SQL；超大规模搜索或复杂相关性调优时 ES 路线更有优势。
